column1: # iota(4,10) >= 28 ?  the deg(0) = 12 floor cube, split by degree sequence.
# Ground set 10, TARGET 28 -- not 32. The target is deliberately in this
# filename: tools/rung.sh derives its checkpoint name from (b, ground)
# alone and its skip test matches the deg column, so a run at one target
# would silently skip cubes recorded at another. See roadmap 46.
# Coarse pass, iota_sym 4 10 28 --seconds 3600, 4 threads:
#   deg(0) = 17..28  UNSAT, none over 90 s
#   deg(0) = 16      UNSAT   153.9 s
#   deg(0) = 15      UNSAT   302.7 s
#   deg(0) = 14      UNSAT  1418.4 s
#   deg(0) = 13      UNSAT  1775.4 s
#   deg(0) = 12      UNKNOWN at 3600 s  -> re-run below
# The floor cube. Degree sum is 4*28 = 112 over ten points, mean 11.2, so
# the maximum degree cannot be below 12; deg(0) = 12 is the floor and the
# family must be near-regular, with only 8 of slack over ten points.
# iota_sym 4 10 28 --only-deg 12 --seconds 36000 --slice 300 --cubecap 400
#   1 of 1 cubes refined -> 144 degree-sequence cubes
#   UNSAT after 37879.5 s, 0 at the limit
# Every sequence below was checked: 144 distinct, each 10 entries summing
# to 112 with maximum 12 at position 0. Sorted within blocks, not
# globally -- that is the sorted_blocks symmetry, so the entries are not
# monotone.
# VERDICT  iota(4,10) <= 27, and iota(4,9) = 27 embeds, so iota(4,10) = 27.
# sequence
